600	English: Before Rosh Hashanah until after Rosh Hashanah, in these Days of Awe, because they understood	Portuguese: Antes de Rosh Hashanah até depois de Rosh Hashanah, nesses Dias Terríveis, pois entenderam
601	English: that because of the power and might of these holy days and the many preparations people make, it is almost impossible to sin.	Portuguese: que, por causa da força e do poder desses dias santos e dos muitos preparativos, é quase impossível pecar.
602	English: So if they went out on bein hazmanim during the days of judgment, Rosh Hashanah, Erev Yom Kippur, no one would do foolish things	Portuguese: Assim, se saíssem de bein hazmanim nos dias de julgamento, Rosh Hashanah, véspera de Yom Kipur, ninguém faria bobagens
603	English: and no one would sin. That is why they chose these times for the yeshiva's bein hazmanim break,	Portuguese: e ninguém pecaria. Por isso escolheram esses tempos para o recesso de bein hazmanim da yeshivá,
604	English: at those times. But in the month of Av they sat in Yeshivat Porat Yosef	Portuguese: nesses períodos. Mas no mês de Av ficavam na Yeshivat Porat Yosef
605	English: and studied as usual, even though in other places they went on bein hazmanim vacations. In	Portuguese: e estudavam como de costume, embora em outros lugares saíssem de férias de bein hazmanim. Na
606	English: Porat Yosef there was no such concept.	Portuguese: Porat Yosef não existia esse conceito.
607	English: There is testimony to this in the book Ha'Ish Al HaEdah, where a letter is printed	Portuguese: Há um testemunho disso no livro Ha'Ish Al HaEdah, onde está impressa uma carta
608	English: from the Gaon Rabbi Silver, who after visiting Yeshivat Porat Yosef	Portuguese: do Gaon Rabino Silver, que, depois de visitar a Yeshivat Porat Yosef,
609	English: praised the level of the students there, especially since it was the month of Av, and he	Portuguese: elogiou o nível dos estudantes de lá, sobretudo por ser o mês de Av, e
610	English: emphasized that Yeshivat Porat Yosef is not like the other yeshivot, which at such times	Portuguese: ressaltou que a Yeshivat Porat Yosef não é como as outras yeshivot, que nessa época
611	English: are on vacation. He even took the trouble to write	Portuguese: estão de férias. Ele chegou a se dar ao trabalho de escrever
612	English: The letter of Rabbi Eliezer, son of Rabbi Bunim Tzemach Silver,	Portuguese: A carta do Rabino Eliezer, filho do Rabino Bunim Tzemach Silver,
613	English: president of the Union of Orthodox Rabbis of the United States and Canada, who was a guest at Yeshivat Porat Yosef in the year	Portuguese: presidente da União dos Rabinos dos Estados Unidos e do Canadá, que foi hóspede da Yeshivat Porat Yosef no ano de
614	English: 5724, when my revered father was still a young student. Rabbi Silver writes	Portuguese: 5724, quando meu pai ainda era um jovem estudante. O Rabino Silver escreve
615	English: in his letter: This afternoon I visited the Porat Yosef	Portuguese: em sua carta: Hoje à tarde visitei a yeshivá Porat Yosef,
616	English: Sephardic yeshiva in the Holy City, and I gave a lecture with pilpul for about three	Portuguese: sefaradita, na Cidade Santa, e dei uma aula com pilpul por cerca de três
617	English: hours, on several proposals and topics in the Shas and the poskim.	Portuguese: horas, sobre várias propostas e temas do Shas e dos poskim.
618	English: There I found, with the help of HaShem, may He be blessed, several of the roshei yeshiva and some of its great students	Portuguese: Ali encontrei, com a ajuda de HaShem, bendito seja, alguns dos roshei yeshivá e vários de seus grandes alunos
619	English: along with some of the younger ones, who engaged me in pilpul across the whole Shas.	Portuguese: com alguns dos mais jovens, que debateram comigo em pilpul por todo o Shas.
620	English: I found them to be great, great in Torah, with erudition and sharpness in several topics	Portuguese: Achei-os grandes, grandes na Torá, com conhecimento e agudeza em vários temas
621	English: in the Shas, able to distinguish and explain, no less than most of the Lithuanian rabbis in the Land of	Portuguese: do Shas, capazes de distinguir e explicar, não menos que a maioria dos rabinos lituanos na Terra de
622	English: Israel.	Portuguese: Israel.
623	English: I am sure, since I saw that most of them are diligent in their studies, even in the days of	Portuguese: Tenho certeza, pois vi que a maioria é dedicada aos estudos, mesmo nos dias de
624	English: vacation they persist in their studies, unlike other yeshivot, and thank HaShem they study day and night	Portuguese: recesso continuam estudando, ao contrário de outras yeshivot, e, graças a HaShem, estudam dia e noite
625	English: even now.	Portuguese: também agora.
626	English: I am certain that they will surely be great men of the world, and some of them will surely merit to be called geonim of	Portuguese: Tenho certeza de que serão com certeza grandes do mundo, e alguns deles certamente merecerão ser chamados de geonim de
627	English: Israel.	Portuguese: Israel.
628	English: I took more interest there in Yeshivat Porat Yosef than in most of the yeshivot I visited in our Holy Land,	Portuguese: Interessei-me ali pela Yeshivat Porat Yosef mais do que pela maioria das yeshivot que visitei em nossa Terra Santa,
629	English: and I blessed that their greatness be known in the world, and that the aforementioned students of Porat Yosef grow and multiply,	Portuguese: e abençoei para que sua grandeza seja conhecida no mundo e que os mencionados alunos da Porat Yosef cresçam e se multipliquem,
630	English: and that the students of Yeshivat Porat Yosef influence the other yeshivot to be like them.	Portuguese: e que os alunos da Yeshivat Porat Yosef influenciem as outras yeshivot para que sejam como eles.
631	English: May they all be blessed with physical health, with a good writing and sealing, with long days and years, and may they call great Torah scholars	Portuguese: Sejam todos abençoados com saúde do corpo, com uma boa inscrição e selo, com longevidade de dias e anos, e que chamem grandes sábios
632	English: like themselves. Blessing them, Eliezer, son of the Gaon Rabbi Bunim Tzemach Silver,	Portuguese: como eles. Os abençoa, Eliezer, filho do Gaon Rabino Bunim Tzemach Silver,
633	English: president of the Union of Orthodox Rabbis of the United States and Canada.	Portuguese: presidente da União dos Rabinos dos Estados Unidos e do Canadá.
634	English: This is a letter of appreciation from an Ashkenazi rosh yeshiva in the United States,	Portuguese: Esta é uma carta de apreço de um rosh yeshivá asquenazita dos Estados Unidos,
635	English: who testifies: they study there during vacation.	Portuguese: que testemunha: lá se estuda durante o recesso.
636	English: There are great men of the world there and future great men of the world, expert in the distinctions throughout	Portuguese: Há ali grandes do mundo e futuros grandes do mundo, versados nas distinções por todo
637	English: the Shas, even among the young students.	Portuguese: o Shas, até entre os alunos jovens.
638	English: He praises these things.	Portuguese: Ele elogia essas coisas.
639	English: There is also a photo of his visit there.	Portuguese: Há também uma foto da visita dele.
640	English: A photo appears there with the students.	Portuguese: Ali aparece uma foto com os alunos.
641	English: You can also see my revered father, peace be upon him, second in the top row from the left,	Portuguese: Vê-se também meu pai, que descanse em paz, o segundo na fileira de cima, a partir da esquerda,
642	English: and you can easily identify my father, because my father is the only one	Portuguese: e dá para identificar meu pai facilmente, porque meu pai é o único
643	English: of all the yeshiva students in the picture, the only one, yes, who did not touch	Portuguese: de todos os alunos da yeshivá na foto, o único, sim, que não tocou
644	English: his beard, even in his bachelor years.	Portuguese: na barba, nem mesmo nos anos de solteiro.
645	English: Today there are great men of the world who came out of Yeshivat Porat Yosef, great men who are still with	Portuguese: Hoje há grandes do mundo que saíram da Yeshivat Porat Yosef, grandes que ainda estão conosco,
646	English: us, who touched their beards when they were at Yeshivat Porat Yosef.	Portuguese: que tocaram nas suas barbas quando estavam na Yeshivat Porat Yosef.
647	English: My father, peace be upon him, is the only one you can see, even in the photo, who did not touch his beard.	Portuguese: Meu pai, que descanse em paz, é o único que se vê, até na foto, que não tocou na barba.
648	English: From his youth, from the world.	Portuguese: Desde a juventude, do mundo.
649	English: That is how he studied Torah with diligence, and that is how he loved Torah and cherished Torah,	Portuguese: Assim estudou Torá com constância, e assim amou a Torá e a estimou,
650	English: it is our life and the length of our days, for he was our teacher, literally.	Portuguese: ela é a nossa vida e a extensão dos nossos dias, pois ele era nosso mestre, literalmente.
651	English: As we told in the previous lectures,	Portuguese: Como contamos nas palestras anteriores,
652	English: until the day of the wedding, and including the day of the wedding.	Portuguese: até o dia do casamento, inclusive o dia do casamento.
653	English: My father sat and studied Torah, and only about an hour before he went to change his clothes and returned	Portuguese: Meu pai sentou e estudou Torá, e só cerca de uma hora antes foi trocar de roupa e voltou
654	English: to the yeshiva's dining hall, got married and returned to his studies.	Portuguese: ao refeitório da yeshivá, casou-se e voltou aos estudos.
655	English: I came across a wonderful book from which I prepared a substantial lecture, the book	Portuguese: Deparei-me com um livro maravilhoso do qual preparei uma aula substancial, o livro
656	English: HaShakdanim, from which I gave a lecture of over four hours,	Portuguese: HaShakdanim, do qual dei uma aula de mais de quatro horas,
657	English: four and a half hours, on the diligence of the great ones of Israel in Torah.	Portuguese: quatro horas e meia, sobre a dedicação dos grandes de Israel à Torá.
658	English: The lecture is called "Love of Torah," and in this book	Portuguese: A aula se chama "Amor à Torá", e neste livro
659	English: I gathered a collection about the great ones of Israel who indeed acted this way,	Portuguese: reuni uma coletânea sobre os grandes de Israel que de fato agiram assim,
660	English: and on their wedding day, including the wedding day, their heads were immersed in Torah.	Portuguese: e no dia do seu casamento, inclusive o dia do casamento, suas cabeças estavam mergulhadas na Torá.
661	English: And my father, peace be upon him, just as he walked the path of sleeping	Portuguese: E meu pai, que descanse em paz, assim como andou pelo caminho de dormir
662	English: in a bed, the path of the great ones of the world who gave no sleep to their eyes on	Portuguese: em cama, o caminho dos grandes do mundo que não davam sono aos seus olhos sobre
663	English: a bed.	Portuguese: uma cama.
664	English: So too in this path, he walked the path of the great ones of Israel,	Portuguese: assim também neste caminho, ele andou pelo caminho dos grandes de Israel,
665	English: that on the wedding day, including the wedding day, his head was immersed in Torah until	Portuguese: de que no dia do casamento, inclusive o dia do casamento, sua cabeça ficava imersa na Torá até
666	English: the moment of the chuppah.	Portuguese: o momento da chupá.
667	English: I will tell a few stories that I found in this book, HaShakdanim,	Portuguese: Contarei algumas histórias que encontrei neste livro, HaShakdanim,
668	English: to complete the picture here and see in which paths, of giant tzaddikim, my father,	Portuguese: para completar o quadro e ver em quais caminhos, de tsadikim gigantes, andou
669	English: peace be upon him, walked.	Portuguese: meu pai, que descanse em paz.
670	English: It is told of the Gaon Rabbi Yehuda Leib Chasman, may the memory of the tzaddik be a blessing, who was the mashgiach of	Portuguese: Conta-se do Gaon Rabi Yehuda Leib Chasman, de bendita memória, que foi mashguiach da
671	English: Yeshivat Chevron, Knesset Yisrael, and author of the book Or Yahel.	Portuguese: Yeshivat Chevron, Knesset Israel, e autor do livro Or Yahel.
672	English: He was a great diligent scholar.	Portuguese: Ele era um grande estudioso constante.
673	English: About his diligence his wife, the Rebbetzin, related that on his wedding day he sat and studied in the	Portuguese: Sobre a sua constância contou sua esposa, a rabanit, que no dia do seu casamento ele sentou e estudou na
674	English: beit midrash as was his custom every day, until the in-laws came as is customary to take him.	Portuguese: casa de estudos como fazia todos os dias, até que os consogros vieram, como é costume, para buscá-lo.
675	English: They came to the beit midrash and told him, the time for the chuppah has come.	Portuguese: Vieram à casa de estudos e disseram-lhe: chegou a hora da chupá.
676	English: Rabbi Yehuda Leib Chasman got up, went to his home, put on his wedding clothes and entered the chuppah.	Portuguese: Rabi Yehuda Leib Chasman levantou-se, foi para casa, vestiu as roupas do casamento e entrou na chupá.
677	English: In the year 5695 was the wedding of the Gaon, Rabbi	Portuguese: No ano de 5695 foi o casamento do Gaon, Rabi
678	English: Matzliach Mazuz, author of Sheelot UTeshuvot, a successful man, may the memory of the tzaddik be a blessing.	Portuguese: Matzliach Mazuz, autor de Sheelot UTeshuvot, homem bem-sucedido, de bendita memória.
679	English: It is told that when all the people came from far and wide to the chuppah and the sheva berachot, they asked for the groom,	Portuguese: Conta-se que, quando todo o povo veio de longe para a chupá e as sheva berachot, perguntaram pelo noivo,
680	English: Rabbi Matzliach Mazuz. They searched for the groom, and relatives went	Portuguese: Rabi Matzliach Mazuz. Procuraram o noivo, e parentes foram
681	English: to his rabbi to ask: where is the groom?	Portuguese: ao seu rabino perguntar: onde está o noivo?
682	English: His rabbi said, I don't know, but presumably you will find him in the books	Portuguese: Seu rabino disse: não sei, mas provavelmente o encontrarão no sótão dos livros
683	English: loft of the Rabbi Eliezer synagogue, his regular place of study.	Portuguese: da sinagoga Rabi Eliezer, seu lugar de estudo de sempre.
684	English: And so it was: the relatives came and found him on his wedding day, immersed head and body in deep	Portuguese: E assim foi: os parentes vieram e o encontraram no dia do casamento, mergulhado de corpo e alma em estudo
685	English: study.	Portuguese: profundo.
686	English: When they asked, where are you?	Portuguese: Quando perguntaram: onde você está?
687	English: He answered, I already bathed and dressed, I'm ready for the summons, when everyone comes, call me and I'll come, it's a pity for	Portuguese: Ele respondeu: já tomei banho e me vesti, estou pronto para o chamado, quando todos vierem, me chamem e eu virei, é uma pena pelos
688	English: the moments that are lost. That was his way in holiness, not to waste a single moment	Portuguese: momentos que se perdem. Esse era o seu caminho na santidade, não desperdiçar nenhum momento
689	English: in vain. Call me when everyone comes and is ready, meanwhile it's a pity about the time.	Portuguese: em vão. Chamem-me quando todos vierem e estiverem prontos, enquanto isso é uma pena perder o tempo.
690	English: About the Gaon Rabbi Eliyahu Feinstein, may the memory of the tzaddik be a blessing, the people of Kletsk would tell	Portuguese: Sobre o Gaon Rabi Eliyahu Feinstein, de bendita memória, as pessoas de Kletsk contavam
691	English: that during his seven days of feasting he almost did not take part in the joy at all, throughout	Portuguese: que durante os sete dias de festa ele quase não tomou parte na alegria, durante todos
692	English: the seven days of feasting, but sat and studied, his head immersed in study all seven days of the wedding.	Portuguese: os sete dias de festa, mas sentou e estudou, a cabeça mergulhada no estudo em todos os sete dias do casamento.
693	English: There was a wedding of Rabbi Meir HaLevi Soloveitchik, who was the youngest son of the Rav	Portuguese: Houve o casamento de Rabi Meir HaLevi Soloveitchik, que era o filho mais novo do Rav
694	English: of Brisk, may his merit protect us.	Portuguese: de Brisk, que o seu mérito nos proteja.
695	English: For the occasion everyone gathered, roshei yeshiva, our masters and rabbis, to take part in the joy of the great ones of the generation.	Portuguese: Para a ocasião todos se reuniram, roshei yeshivá, nossos mestres e rabinos, para participar da alegria dos grandes da geração.
696	English: This was in its time in Tel Aviv.	Portuguese: Isso foi na época em Tel Aviv.
697	English: It was the wedding of Rabbi Meir HaLevi Soloveitchik, youngest son of the Rav of Brisk.	Portuguese: Foi o casamento de Rabi Meir HaLevi Soloveitchik, filho mais novo do Rav de Brisk.
698	English: Among those who came to the wedding was also the Steipler, may his merit protect us.	Portuguese: Entre os que vieram ao casamento estava também o Steipler, que o seu mérito nos proteja.
699	English: The Steipler arrived at the hall, entered the hall, leaned on his cane, and discovered	Portuguese: O Steipler chegou ao salão, entrou, apoiou-se na bengala e descobriu
700	English: that the groom and the rest of the family had not yet arrived.	Portuguese: que o noivo e o restante da família ainda não tinham chegado.
701	English: What does the Steipler do?	Portuguese: O que faz o Steipler?
702	English: For a few minutes he waits, and suddenly he disappears.	Portuguese: Por alguns minutos ele espera, e de repente desaparece.
703	English: A quarter of an hour later the Rav of Brisk suddenly arrives with	Portuguese: Um quarto de hora depois chega de repente o Rav de Brisk com
704	English: the groom, his son, and without delay they proceed to the chuppah, the Rav	Portuguese: o noivo, seu filho, e sem demora vão para a chupá, o Rav
705	English: of Brisk himself arranges the kiddushin and reads the ketubah.	Portuguese: de Brisk conduz pessoalmente o kidushin e lê a ketubá.
706	English: The seventh blessing of the sheva berachot, the final blessing, the Rav of Brisk wanted	Portuguese: A sétima bênção das sheva berachot, a última bênção, o Rav de Brisk queria
707	English: for the Steipler, Rabbi Yaakov Kanievsky, they announce, they call him,	Portuguese: para o Steipler, Rabi Yaakov Kanievsky, anunciam, chamam por ele,
708	English: to approach the chuppah to recite the blessing, but the Steipler, Rabbi Yaakov, had disappeared.	Portuguese: para se aproximar da chupá e recitar a bênção, mas o Steipler, Rabi Yaakov, havia desaparecido.
709	English: After a few minutes of searching someone remembered that the Steipler had asked where there is	Portuguese: Depois de alguns minutos de busca alguém lembrou que o Steipler tinha perguntado onde havia
710	English: a beit midrash in the area.	Portuguese: uma casa de estudos na região.
711	English: It's a pity about the time, since he came a quarter of an hour before the in-laws, so he went to a nearby beit midrash	Portuguese: É uma pena perder o tempo, pois ele chegou um quarto de hora antes dos consogros, então foi a uma casa de estudos próxima
712	English: and went to study there. With no alternative, the seventh blessing was given to someone else.	Portuguese: e foi estudar ali. Sem alternativa, a sétima bênção foi dada a outra pessoa.
713	English: Hours passed, in the depth of the night, when	Portuguese: Passaram-se horas, em plena noite, quando
714	English: night had already fallen, the Steipler arrived, approached warmly, wished mazal	Portuguese: a noite já havia caído, o Steipler chegou, aproximou-se cordialmente, desejou mazal
715	English: tov, and explained that he had decided to use the time until the chuppah for study in the beit	Portuguese: tov e explicou que decidira aproveitar o tempo até a chupá para estudar na casa de	
716	English: midrash, but once he began to study he sank into the Talmud, and only after several hours of in-depth study did he	Portuguese: estudos, mas quando começou a estudar mergulhou no Talmud, e só depois de várias horas de estudo profundo	
717	English: remember that he was in Tel Aviv, that he had come here for some wedding.	Portuguese: lembrou que estava em Tel Aviv, que tinha vindo para algum casamento.
718	English: Our teacher the Steipler was so immersed in study that he forgot even the wedding of the gadol hador.	Portuguese: Nosso mestre, o Steipler, mergulhou tanto no estudo que esqueceu até o casamento do grande da geração.
719	English: It's a pity about the time spent waiting until the wedding.	Portuguese: É uma pena o tempo que se espera até o casamento.
